title: Code Cultivation
note: Subject v2.1 (v2.0 only differs in ex1: v2.1 adds "You can use the name you want for each attribute"). The output is yours to design: the run must not crash (KO), the subject's markers are only a warning. The structure is checked for real: classes / methods the subject asks for, inheritance, super() in each subclass, show() of the subclasses, protected height / age (other public attributes are a warning, errors may go to stdout or stderr), validation in the setters, static / class methods, nested stats class that really counts the calls. Source: authorized builtins, no import, type hints, PascalCase / snake_case naming, flake8, mypy.
